Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

Record Class SnmpV3Config

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config
public record SnmpV3Config(String username, SnmpV3Config.SecurityLevel level, SnmpV3Config.AuthProtocol authProtocol, String authPassword, SnmpV3Config.PrivProtocol privProtocol, String privPassword, String contextName) extends Record
A typed, validated SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM) configuration. This is the config shape the browser would hand to an engine; it carries the security name, security level, and the authentication / privacy protocols and passphrases — no live USM engine is involved here.

The model is pure and side-effect free. validate() encodes the USM rules: a security name is always required; authNoPriv/authPriv need an auth protocol and an RFC 3414 passphrase of at least eight characters; authPriv additionally needs a privacy protocol and passphrase. It is fully unit-testable offline.
